quiz.question: What does it mean for Dart to be a "single-threaded" language?

answers.answer: It can execute multiple instructions at the exact same time.
It can only have one `main()` function in a program.
It can only run on computers with a single-core processor.
It can only execute one instruction at a time.

quiz.question: What is the primary role of the Event Loop in Dart?

answers.answer: To execute multiple tasks in parallel on different threads.
To manage a queue of tasks so they can be run concurrently without blocking the program.
To check for syntax errors in your code before it runs.
To store variables and function definitions in memory.

quiz.question: Imagine your app needs to download an image from the internet. Why is it beneficial to perform this task asynchronously?

answers.answer: It makes the internet connection faster, so the image downloads in less time.
It prevents the user interface from becoming unresponsive while the image is downloading.
It guarantees the downloaded image will not have any errors.
It reduces the memory used by the program during the download.
